name: deck-style-safe-beautify
title: PPT 保风格美化
description: Beautify an existing .pptx with themed, semantic decoration while provably preserving text, layout, shapes, color scheme, and filename.

install_targets.instructions: Read AGENTS.md as workspace instructions, or inject SKILL.md body as a system/user prompt. No runtime, no SDK, no network required.

scripts.purpose: Extract page count, shape signatures, gradient colors, palette, texts, existing timing/transition.
Prove zero changes to text/layout/shapes/gradient and quantify center-vs-edge render difference.
Pick the emptiest corner per page from real rendered pixels.
Reusable code-rendered decoration primitives (stars, magnifier, dot grid, highlighter, sticker, cards, letter).
Rebuild the exact original gradient and composite decoration into per-page backgrounds.
Insert one full-page decoration picture per slide at spTree index 1, from the pristine original.
Remove generated-image watermarks and cut RGB pseudo-transparent images to clean alpha.
Inject gentle p:transition after clrMapOvr, preserving all original p:timing.

guarantees: one decoration layer per slide, behind all content
non_goals: guaranteeing Microsoft PowerPoint compatibility for hand-written OOXML
